title: Parañaque Titans bag second straight Maharlika Pilipinas Pickleball Tour Invitational crown
summary: The Parañaque Titans took down Tacloban, 3-1, to emerge triumphant in the second leg of the Maharlika Pilipinas Pickleball Tour (MPPT) Invitational at the Tagaytay Velodrome.
